# No Code MBA

> > No Code MBA teaches entrepreneurs to build websites, apps, and AI-powered SaaS products using no-code tools like Webflow, Bubble, Lovable, and Cursor—no programming required.

Founded by Seth, No Code MBA offers courses, tutorials, and tool overviews for building digital products without traditional coding. The platform specializes in teaching AI app development, web design, and automation workflows using modern no-code and AI-powered builders.

## Key Topics

- Webflow
- Bubble
- Lovable
- Cursor
- Bolt AI App Builder
- Airtable
- Zapier
- Glide
- FlutterFlow
- AI-powered apps
- SaaS development
- No-code platforms
- App development
- E-commerce
- AI automation

- [The AI SaaS Course - Learning Track](https://www.nocode.mba/tracks/The-AI-SaaS-Course): Build SaaS products with Lovable and Cursor from idea to customers
